title: InspectionRequested, version 1
description: core to ai: a user started a simulated inspection of an establishment. The AI service runs it and reports with the ai to core inspection events.

jurisdiction.description: The establishment's jurisdiction; it picks the checklist and the regulation.

establishmentType.description: Picks the checklist items that apply.

tokenCeiling.description: Model tokens (input and output) the inspection may spend. It fails with budget_exceeded before a call that could pass it.

requestedBy.description: The requesting user's sub, recorded with each model call's usage.
